# Spiritual Translation

** ¶7:** In the same way, the good that the Lord has implanted within a person — that living good which today exists ent angled with evils and falsities in the natural mind — l ongs in wardly to be elevated and to return to the heavenly kingdom where its kind d well. Yet it perce ives and understands that there is no open communication through any faculty of the internal or external person, for every faculty has been seized by opposing states; fals ities and self -derived evils press upon it from every quarter. Indeed , there is no passage for it except through Divine Love and Divine Wisdom themselves — the two lumin aries that govern the spiritual heav ens. These alone become the state of peace for the good within . And they become the communication that opens for it in the process of regener ation, so that the living good passes out through reception of the Divine and enters into the heavenly kingdom where its own kind dwell.

**¶ 8:** And further still within : Divine Love and Divine Wisdom themselves , as received in the spiritual mind, find no state of rest among any of the intermediate or lower faculties of the person — except in the Lord 's own infinite presence, which has been their origin from eternity.

**¶9 :** Thus the living good within is separated and purified from all falsity through temptation and va station; and the Divine provides a state of heavenly peace for it, and opens full communication with the kingdom where its own kind dwell.

** ¶10:** And it is so that the Lord 's own infinite being becomes the ultimate ground into which Divine Love and Divine Wisdom return; and they rest within Him and govern from Him forever.

Also, it is the case that the land of lig[ht] will become the final receiver for the light-givers of [the] heavens, and they will rest themselves therein and rule in it [for] ever.
